added: A Rory O'More can have one role, or the ends of the wave, slide two places across the set while the others slide one: set "two places" in the dance editor, and the line reads "balance & Rory O'More left, robins 2 places". Typing or pasting that line reads it back.

Dances from The Caller's Box that write the longer slide straight after a wave balance, such as "Slide left, women slide two places" in Leap of Faith, now import it as part of that Rory O'More instead of leaving it as text.

Add `rory_o_more.twoPlaces` (contra taxonomy v40): `role1s`, `role2s` or `ends`, stored only while stated and shown only in the display summary, with a display read-back and The Caller's Box adapter's fold of a two-place slide after a balance-wave line.
